Then we can estimate drive feasibility by mileage: estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance). That probably uses fuel consumption data. Or we could manually compute but better to use the tool.

So plan: call get_zipcode_based_on_city for SF, then for Rivermist. Then call estimate_distance with those zipcodes. Then call displayCarStatus(option="fuel") to get fuel. Then call estimate_drive_feasibility_by_mileage(distance). Then combine results.
